drakish_ember_memory.description: Your dragon slashes, fireballs, Wing Rebuke, Ancient Pact and every 3rd basic attack set the target burning for {effect}% of the hit over 3s.

drakish_ancient_pact.name: Ancient Pact
drakish_ancient_pact.description: Land in full dragon form: after a 0.6s warning the landing circle (5m) deals {effect} fire damage. For 10s you and allies within 5m take 20% less damage, and your dragon form lasts the whole time with unlimited cleaving slashes.

level15.label: Lv 15: +burn for 40% of the hit over 4s

ultimateUpgrade.name: Scaled Oath
ultimateUpgrade.text: Allies within 8 m gain +40 ward and +20 armor for 8 s.

troll_axe_frenzy.name: Axe Frenzy
troll_axe_frenzy.description: Commit to a 1.2s dual-axe frenzy: 5 rapid hits of {effect} damage on your target; you are slowed 50% while committed.

troll_blood_leap.name: Bloodbound Leap
troll_blood_leap.description: Leap to a warned spot up to 7m away and cleave everything within 3m on landing for {effect} damage; a void rift at the landing stuns the centre and slows the ring.

troll_hunger.name: Berserker Hunger
troll_hunger.description: Gain {effect}% attack speed for every 10% of health you are missing (up to +40%).

troll_red_moon.name: Red Moon Frenzy
troll_red_moon.description: Red Moon Frenzy for 8s: +{effect}% attack speed, 15% lifesteal, and every basic attack also strikes a second enemy within 2.5m for half damage (melee cleave or split throw).

ultimateUpgrade.name: Blood Moon
ultimateUpgrade.text: You gain +20% lifesteal and +20% attack speed for 8 s.

troll_twin_throw.name: Twin Throw
troll_twin_throw.description: Throw two axes in a narrow fork (6 degrees apart): each strikes the first enemy in its path for {effect} damage.

troll_returning_axes.name: Returning Axes
troll_returning_axes.description: Hurl an axe down a warned lane (11m x 1.4m) that returns to you: enemies take {effect} damage on the way out and again on the way back.

dryad_root_snare.name: Root Snare
dryad_root_snare.description: Roots burst from a warned circle (2.5m) after 0.6s: {effect} damage and enemies are rooted for 2s.

dryad_seed_mend.name: Seed Mend
dryad_seed_mend.description: Cast 1s: plant a healing seed on an ally (or yourself); after 2s it blooms for {effect} healing, 50% more if they are below 40% health.

dryad_thorn_line.name: Thornweave
dryad_thorn_line.description: Weave a line of thorns (9m x 1.8m) for 5s: enemies on it take {effect} damage per second and are slowed 35%.

dryad_green_covenant.name: Green Covenant
dryad_green_covenant.description: 20% of your effective healing is banked in a regeneration reserve (up to {effect}, scaling with Primary) that heals the most wounded ally within 12m every 2s.

dryad_grove_renewal.name: Grove Renewal
dryad_grove_renewal.description: Cast 2s: grow a sanctuary of healing trees (6m) for 8s: living allies inside regenerate {effect} health per second and take 15% less damage.

ultimateUpgrade.name: Heartwood
ultimateUpgrade.text: Allies within 8 m lose their slows and gain a shield absorbing 150 + 2x primary stat for 8 s.

whisp_guiding_mote.name: Guiding Mote
whisp_guiding_mote.description: Cast 1s: send a mote down a line (12m); the first ally it reaches is healed for {effect}. With no ally in its path it bursts at the end, healing allies within 2m.

whisp_spirit_tether.name: Spirit Tether
whisp_spirit_tether.description: Cast 0.5s: tether an ally within 7m for 6s; they heal {effect} per second. The tether snaps if they move beyond 9m.

whisp_fey_trail.name: Fey Trail
whisp_fey_trail.description: Cast 0.8s: lay a luminous trail of 5 motes (8m) for 6s; an ally touching a mote consumes it and heals {effect}.

whisp_lantern_soul.name: Lantern Soul
whisp_lantern_soul.description: While you are within 6m of an ally below 60% health, your mana regenerates {effect}% faster.

whisp_constellation.name: Kindred Constellation
whisp_constellation.description: Cast 1.5s: link every living ally within 9m for 8s; each link pulses {effect} healing every 2s while the ally stays within 12m.

ultimateUpgrade.name: Starlit Well
ultimateUpgrade.text: Allies within 9 m heal 150 and restore 15% of their max mana.

centaur_grove_javelin.name: Grove Javelin
centaur_grove_javelin.description: Hurl a root-tipped javelin: the first enemy hit takes {effect} damage and a healing bloom (2.5m) grows there for 3s, healing allies inside for 50% of the damage.

centaur_trailblaze.name: Evergrove Trail
centaur_trailblaze.description: Blaze a warned path (9m x 2.8m) for 5s: allies on it move {effect}% faster.

centaur_herd_call.name: Herd Call
centaur_herd_call.description: Summon a spectral grove stag for 15s: it attacks your target for {effect} per hit.

centaur_steady_gait.name: Steady Gait
centaur_steady_gait.description: After 2s of moving without taking damage, your next heal is {effect}% stronger.

centaur_spring_march.name: Spring March
centaur_spring_march.description: Cast 1s: for 8s a grove aura travels with you (6m): allies inside regenerate {effect} health per second and move 15% faster.

ultimateUpgrade.name: Spring Stride
ultimateUpgrade.text: Allies within 9 m lose their slows and gain +20% move speed for 8 s.

keeper_dawn_beam.name: Dawn Beam
keeper_dawn_beam.description: Cast 1.2s: a warned beam of dawn (10m x 2m): allies in it are healed for {effect}; enemies take 40% of it as holy damage and receive 30% less healing for 4s.

keeper_lantern_ward.name: Lantern Ward
keeper_lantern_ward.description: Place a destructible Lantern Ward (12s): every 3s allies within 4.5m gain a {effect} barrier (refreshed; barriers never stack).

keeper_beacon.name: Beacon of Return
keeper_beacon.description: Raise a Beacon of Return (4m) for 8s: allies inside move {effect}% faster and regenerate 1% of their max health per second.

keeper_last_light.name: Last Light
keeper_last_light.description: When an ally within 12m drops below 30% health they gain a {effect} barrier for 6s (once per ally every 20s).

aura15.label: Lv 15 aura: party 15% chance to resist area damage

keeper_sunrise.name: Sunrise Vigil
keeper_sunrise.description: Cast 2s: a broad sunrise (9m) restores living allies for {effect} health per second for 6s and clears their slows.

ultimateUpgrade.name: High Noon
ultimateUpgrade.text: Allies within 9 m gain +8 primary stat and +20 ward for 8 s.

riposte_roll.name: Riposte
riposte_roll.description: A hit you dodge during the roll's i-frames triggers a counter strike on the attacker for {effect} stat damage (once per roll).

tumblers_edge.name: Tumbler's Edge
tumblers_edge.description: After a roll, your next basic attack within 4s deals {effect}% more damage.

aura15.label: Lv 15 aura: party 15% chance to resist area damage

killer_instinct.name: Killer Instinct
killer_instinct.description: After a roll, your next basic attack within 4s is a guaranteed critical strike.

fleet_recovery.name: Fleet Recovery
fleet_recovery.description: Every dodge roll restores {effect}% of your maximum health stat.

windrunner.name: Windrunner
windrunner.description: Every dodge roll grants {effect}% movement speed for 5s.

quickened_mind.name: Quickened Mind
quickened_mind.description: After a roll, your next spell with a cast time (within {effect}s) is cast instantly.

hasted_tumble.name: Hasted Tumble
hasted_tumble.description: Every dodge roll shortens the remaining cooldowns of your active skills by {effect}%.

aura15.label: Lv 15 aura: party 10% chance to attack twice

ember_wake.name: Ember Wake
ember_wake.description: Your roll leaves a line of embers: enemies within 1.8m of the path take {effect} stat fire damage.

frost_wake.name: Frost Wake
frost_wake.description: Your roll leaves a frost trail: enemies within 1.8m of the path take {effect} stat damage and are slowed 40% for 3s.

aura15.label: Lv 15 aura: party 10% chance to attack twice

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.description: Each roll grants a Momentum stack for 8s (max 5): +{effect}% damage per stack.

blur_step.name: Blur
blur_step.description: After a roll you blur for 3s: {effect}% chance to dodge incoming attacks.

aura15.label: Lv 15 aura: party 5% chance to ignore stuns

slippery_roll.name: Slippery
slippery_roll.description: Every dodge roll cleanses one debuff: slows first, then healing cuts, silences and armor breaks.

bloodrush.name: Bloodrush
bloodrush.description: Killing an enemy resets your dodge roll cooldown and refunds its energy.

aura15.label: Lv 15 aura: party 15% chance to resist area damage

tumble_strike.name: Tumble Strike
tumble_strike.description: Roll toward your target (ignores the dodge cooldown and triggers your roll skills), then strike for {effect} stat damage.

mine_layer.name: Caltrop Mine
mine_layer.description: For 8s your next roll drops a caltrop mine (20s, up to 2): the first enemy within 1.5m sets it off for {effect} stat damage and a 50% slow for 2s in 2.5m.

taunting_tumble.name: Taunting Tumble
taunting_tumble.description: For 8s each roll taunts monsters within 5m for {effect}s and guards you (20% damage reduction) briefly.

shield_tumble.name: Shield Tumble
shield_tumble.description: For 10s each roll grants the nearest ally within 8m a 40% guard for 3s and a Tumbling Mend: {effect}% of their max health + 1x your primary stat healed over 3s.

venom_tumble.name: Venom Tumble
venom_tumble.description: For 8s your rolls leave venom: enemies within 1.8m of the path take {effect} stat damage and receive 30% less healing for 5s.

shadow_dance.name: Shadow Dance

evasive_stance.name: Evasive Stance
evasive_stance.description: For 6s rolls refund their energy and every hit you dodge during i-frames starts an Evasive Mend: {effect}% max health stat healed over 3s.
